annotations.title: Do AI assistants cite us? (quick, under $1)

description: Use when the user asks whether their brand or website shows up in AI answers and a quick read is enough. Asks ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity the buyer's question live with web search on, twice each on the everyday model, and returns per platform: in how many askings the domain was cited and at what positions and whether that held both times, plus the domains cited most instead (not the answers themselves). No flagship-model comparison; that is run_ai_visibility. Buy more runs to cover more questions. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Price: $0.74 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $1.06 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token). Fixed price per run, not per answer. Charged in full when at least 3 of 4 platforms are measured (a platform counts when both of its 2 askings answer with sources); otherwise it refuses and nothing is charged. So a charged run can rest on fewer than all 8 answers; the result reports exactly how many, per platform. A real sample of this run, free: https://cultmath.com/agent/samples/ai-visibility-quick.json
